subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Modeling Best Practices
description: A 60-second lesson on Data Modeling Best Practices.

hook.text: A warehouse with 500 tables and no naming convention is a maze. Data modeling brings order to chaos.

buildup.text: Staging models clean raw data. Intermediate models join and enrich. Mart models serve business questions.

discovery.text: A consistent naming convention — stg_, int_, fct_, dim_ — makes every table's purpose instantly clear.

twist.text: Over-modeling slows you down. Under-modeling creates confusion. The right level depends on your team's scale.

climax.text: Good modeling makes data self-documenting. Users find what they need without asking the data team.

punchline.text: Name it well. Layer it clearly. Model for understanding.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of staging models in a data warehouse?
options: To clean and standardize raw data from sources
